limitations: Paper full text is paywalled; Supplementary Methods PDF and PRIDE protocols were used; no per-sample metadata table exists.

Biological independence between enrichments is not documented: each enrichment is its own source with biological replicate 1; Supplementary Methods describe one digest (~100 mg) per organism from which all enrichments and the proteome aliquot appear to derive.

The acetyl-lysine, succinyl-lysine and diGly-lysine enrichments have no specific EFO/PRIDE term under EFO:0009090 (live OLS checked; only 'enrichment of phosphorylated protein' is PTM-specific), so they carry distinct free-text values in characteristics[enrichment process] and the factor value; parse_sdrf reports these as warnings.
SENSITIVE vs VERY-SENSITIVE MS methods (MS2 resolution 35k vs 70k, max IT 125 vs 250 ms) are encoded only as technical replicate 1/2; there is no SDRF column for the instrument method.
sdrf-tools reconcile reports 'cleavage_agent_incomplete (missing Lys-C)' because it reads one value of a repeated column; the file declares both Trypsin and Lys-C.
Two columns were added by a documented post-processing script (PTM-specific modification parameters, second cleavage agent) after sdrf-tools build; diff-verified that only those cells changed.

HeLa phospho set 1 (QE Plus, 2014-08-10, vials A02-A07) and set 2 ('hs_hela_phos2-2', 2014-08-29, vials D02-D07) are separate enrichments/preparations; whether they come from separate cultures is not documented, so both carry biological replicate 1.
HeLa phospho set 1 file numbering F11-F16 kept as fraction identifiers 11-16 (fractions 1-10 not deposited/undocumented).
Passage number, sample storage temperature and individual are not available.
HeLa succinyl runs exist only with the VERY-SENSITIVE method (technical replicate 1).
